# Breast - Validation

**Breast cancer screening with MCED (Alternate modality) should begin only in 2025. Digital radiography should be identical between scenarios beforehand. MCED spikes every 3 years, as it should.**
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

breastScreening <- importedData$Breast_Cancer_Screen_Outcome_Modality_Table %>%
  filter(expr_name == "Number_of_breast_cancer_screens", Hackable_province == "all", Breast_screening_modalities %in% c("Digital_radiography_mammogram", "Alternative_modality_E"), Age == "all", Shiftable_year != "all", ) %>%
  mutate(Shiftable_year = as.numeric(Shiftable_year))

breastScreening <- breastScreening %>% filter(formattedName %in% c("CancerSeek\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "Galleri\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "BaseCase"))

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = expr_value, colour = sce), data = breastScreening) +
  facet_grid(vars(Breast_screening_modalities), scales = "free") +
  geom_line()


ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = expr_value, colour = Breast_screening_modalities), data = breastScreening) +
  facet_grid(vars(sce), scales = "free") +
  geom_smooth()

```

**All screens performed should be MCED. All and alternate_modality should perfectly overlap.**

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

breastScreening2 <- importedData$Breast_Cancer_Screen_Outcome_Modality_Table %>%
  filter(expr_name == "Number_of_breast_cancer_screens", Hackable_province == "all", Breast_screening_modalities %in% c("all", "Alternative_modality_E"), Age == "all", Shiftable_year != "all", ) %>%
  mutate(Shiftable_year = as.numeric(Shiftable_year))

breastScreening2 <- breastScreening2 %>% filter(formattedName %in% c("CancerSeek\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "Galleri\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "BaseCase"))

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = expr_value, colour = Breast_screening_modalities), data = breastScreening2) +
  facet_grid(vars(sce), scales = "free") +
  geom_line()


```

**Detections should differ between all scenarios. If they are the same for MCED scenarios, then sensitivity/specificity is improper configured. CancerSeek should detect more than Galleri**

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

detections <- importedData$Breast_Cancer_Cases_Table %>%
  filter(expr_name == "Breast_cancer_detected_by_screen", Hackable_province == "all", Shiftable_year != "all", ) %>%
  mutate(Shiftable_year = as.numeric(Shiftable_year))

detections <- detections %>% filter(formattedName %in% c("CancerSeek\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "Galleri\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "BaseCase"))

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = expr_value, colour = sce), data = detections) +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("Breast_cancer_detected_by_screen")

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = expr_value, colour = sce), data = detections) +
  geom_smooth() +
  ggtitle("Breast_cancer_detected_by_screen - Smooth")
```

**MCED should be more expensive than conventional. Galleri should be the most expensive**

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

breastCost <- importedData$Breast_Cancer_Costs_Table %>%
  filter(expr_name == "Cost_of_screening", Hackable_province == "all", Shiftable_year != "all", ) %>%
  mutate(Shiftable_year = as.numeric(Shiftable_year))

breastCost <- breastCost %>% filter(formattedName %in% c("CancerSeek\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "Galleri\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "BaseCase"))

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = expr_value, colour = sce), data = breastCost) +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("Cost_of_screening")

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = expr_value, colour = sce), data = breastCost) +
  geom_smooth() +
  ggtitle("Cost_of_screening - Smooth")
```

# Colorectal - Validation

**FOBT Testing should only start in 2025 (MCED). Screening should be identical between Galleri and CancerSeek**

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

colonScreening <- importedData$Colorectal_Cancer_Screen_Table %>%
  filter(expr_name %in% c("Screens_by_FOBT", "Screens_by_FIT"), Hackable_province == "all", Shiftable_year != "all", ) %>%
  mutate(Shiftable_year = as.numeric(Shiftable_year))

colonScreening <- colonScreening %>% filter(formattedName %in% c("CancerSeek\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "Galleri\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "BaseCase"))

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = expr_value, colour = sce), data = colonScreening) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number) +
  facet_grid(vars(expr_name), scales = "free") +
  geom_line()

```


**All screens performed should be MCED.**
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

colonScreening2 <- importedData$Colorectal_Cancer_Screen_Table %>%
  filter(expr_name %in% c("Screens_by_FOBT", "Total_screens_x_iple_per_visit"), Hackable_province == "all", Shiftable_year != "all", ) %>%
  mutate(Shiftable_year = as.numeric(Shiftable_year))

colonScreening2 <- colonScreening2 %>% filter(formattedName %in% c("CancerSeek\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "Galleri\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "BaseCase"))

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = expr_value, colour = expr_name), data = colonScreening2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number) +
  facet_grid(vars(sce), scales = "free") +
  geom_line()

```


**Screening should approximate 90%.**
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# Including only 50-75 for simplicity
participation <- importedData$Colorectal_Cancer_Timing_Of_Last_Screen %>%
  filter(Colorectal_cancer_family_history == "all", age_group %in% c("[50,60)", "[60,70)", "[70,75)"), Time_of_last_screen_years %in% c("Last_screen_within_0_1", "Last_screen_within_1_2", "Last_screen_within_2_3", "all"), Shiftable_year != "all") %>%
  group_by(Time_of_last_screen_years, Shiftable_year, sce) %>%
  summarize(expr_value = sum(expr_value)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Time_of_last_screen_years, values_from = expr_value) %>%
  mutate(percentScreenedWithin3Years = (Last_screen_within_0_1 + Last_screen_within_1_2 + Last_screen_within_2_3) / all, Shiftable_year = as.numeric(Shiftable_year))


ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = percentScreenedWithin3Years, colour = sce), data = participation) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number) +
  geom_line()

```


**Cancer detections should be different between Galleri and CancerSeek.**

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

colonDetections <- importedData$Colorectal_Cancer_Screen_Table %>%
  filter(expr_name %in% c("Screen_detected_cancers"), Hackable_province == "all", Shiftable_year != "all", ) %>%
  mutate(Shiftable_year = as.numeric(Shiftable_year))


colonDetections <- colonDetections %>% filter(formattedName %in% c("CancerSeek\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "Galleri\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "BaseCase"))

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = expr_value, colour = sce), data = colonDetections) +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("Screen_detected_cancers")

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = expr_value, colour = sce), data = colonDetections) +
  geom_smooth() +
  ggtitle("Screen_detected_cancers - Smooth")

```

**MCED should be more expensive than conventional. Galleri should be the most expensive**

```{r}

colonCost <- importedData$Colorectal_Cancer_ICER_Table %>%
```

# Lung - Validation


**There does not seem to be an elegant way to fully separate conventional screens from MCED. By default, there is no lung cancer screening in OncoSim. **

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

lungScreens <- importedData$Lung_Cancer_ScreenCases_Year_Table %>%
  filter(expr_name == "Total_screens_attended", Year %in% 2020:2050, Hackable_province == "all") %>%
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(Year))


lungScreens <- lungScreens %>% filter(formattedName %in% c("CancerSeek\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "Galleri\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "BaseCase"))

ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = expr_value, colour = sce), data = lungScreens) +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("Total_screens_attended")

ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = expr_value, colour = sce), data = lungScreens) +
  geom_smooth() +
  ggtitle("Total_screens_attended - Smooth")

```


**Screening should approximate 90%.**
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# Including only 50-75 for simplicity
participation <- importedData$Lung_Cancer_Timing_Of_Last_Screen %>%
  filter(age_group %in% c("[50,60)", "[60,70)", "[70,75)"), Time_of_last_screen_years %in% c("Last_screen_within_0_1", "Last_screen_within_1_2", "Last_screen_within_2_3", "all", "Never_screened"), Shiftable_year != "all") %>%
  group_by(Time_of_last_screen_years, Shiftable_year, sce) %>%
  summarize(expr_value = sum(expr_value)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Time_of_last_screen_years, values_from = expr_value) %>%
  mutate(percentScreenedWithin3Years = (Last_screen_within_0_1 + Last_screen_within_1_2 + Last_screen_within_2_3) / all, percentScreenedEver = 1 - (Never_screened / all), Shiftable_year = as.numeric(Shiftable_year))


ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = percentScreenedWithin3Years, colour = sce), data = participation) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number) +
  geom_line()

```


**Cancer detections should be different between Galleri and CancerSeek. Galleri should be higher**


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

lungDetections <- importedData$Lung_Cancer_ScreenCases_Year_Table %>%
  filter(expr_name == "Screen_detecte_x_over_detected", Year %in% 2020:2050, Hackable_province == "all") %>%
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(Year))


lungDetections <- lungDetections %>% filter(formattedName %in% c("CancerSeek\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "Galleri\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "BaseCase"))

ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = expr_value, colour = sce), data = lungDetections) +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("Screen_detecte_x_over_detected")

ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = expr_value, colour = sce), data = lungDetections) +
  geom_smooth() +
  ggtitle("Screen_detecte_x_over_detected - Smooth")

```

**Screening should cost more in the MCED scenarios, especially in Galleri.**
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

lungCost <- importedData$Lung_Cancer_ICER_Table %>%

lungCost <- lungCost %>% filter(formattedName %in% c("CancerSeek\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "Galleri\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "BaseCase"))

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = expr_value, colour = sce), data = lungCost) +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("Cost_of_screen_x_tected_cancers")

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = expr_value, colour = sce), data = lungCost) +
  geom_smooth() +
```

# Cervical - Validation

### POTENTIAL ISSUE: MCED sensitivity and specificity apply to regular screening before 2025. Some cases diagnosed/missed with MCED level sensitivity/specificity could leak over to the current screening era

**Conventional screening should stop in 2025. MCED should begin immediately after**

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

cervicalScreens <- importedData$Hpv_Screening_Costs_Prov_Table %>%
  filter(expr_name == "Primary_cytology_screening_count", Shiftable_year %in% 2020:2050, Hackable_province == "all", Sex == "all") %>%
  mutate(Shiftable_year = as.numeric(Shiftable_year))


cervicalScreens <- cervicalScreens %>% filter(formattedName %in% c("CancerSeek\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "Galleri\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "BaseCase"))

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = expr_value, colour = sce), data = cervicalScreens) +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("Primary_cytology_screening_count")

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = expr_value, colour = sce), data = cervicalScreens) +
  geom_smooth() +
  ggtitle("Primary_cytology_screening_count - Smooth")

```


**There should be a different number of detections between MCED and BaseCase. Galleri should perform better**

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

cervicalDetections <- importedData$Cervical_Cancer_Cases_Table %>%
  filter(expr_name == "Cervical_cance_x_ected_by_screen", Shiftable_year %in% 2020:2050, Hackable_province == "all") %>%

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = expr_value, colour = sce), data = cervicalDetections) +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("Cervical_cance_x_ected_by_screen")

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = expr_value, colour = sce), data = cervicalDetections) +
  geom_smooth() +
  ggtitle("Cervical_cance_x_ected_by_screen - Smooth")

```

# Combined - Validation

**Screening numbers (Breast, Cervical X2) should be similar.**

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

PrimaryTable <- combinedTables$PrimaryTable

PrimaryTable <- PrimaryTable %>% filter(formattedName %in% c("CancerSeek\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "Galleri\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years", "BaseCase"))


PrimaryTable$SexAdjustedScreens <- PrimaryTable$Total_Screens


PrimaryTable$SexAdjustedScreens[PrimaryTable$cancertype %in% c("breast", "cervical")] <- PrimaryTable$SexAdjustedScreens[PrimaryTable$cancertype %in% c("breast", "cervical")] * 2


ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = Total_Screens, colour = cancertype), data = PrimaryTable) +
  facet_grid(vars(sce), scales = "free") +
  geom_line()

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = SexAdjustedScreens, colour = cancertype), data = PrimaryTable) +
  facet_grid(vars(sce), scales = "free") +
  geom_line()

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = Cancer_Deaths, colour = sce), data = PrimaryTable) +
  facet_grid(vars(cancertype), scales = "free") +
  geom_line()

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = Detected_Cases, colour = sce), data = PrimaryTable) +
  facet_grid(vars(cancertype), scales = "free") +
  geom_line()

ggplot(aes(x = Shiftable_year, y = Screening_Cost, colour = sce), data = PrimaryTable) +
  facet_grid(vars(cancertype), scales = "free") +
  geom_line()

```
